name: grounded-copy
description: Help AI write clearly and get to the point.

interface.shortDescription: Help AI write clearly and get to the point.
interface.longDescription: Grounded Copy guides AI agents to explain ideas in plain language, use concrete facts, and remove filler. It applies writing rules to everyday interaction and ordinary documents, with a separate mode for product pages and marketing copy. A Python checker flags supported wording patterns in saved drafts for review.
defaultPrompt: Switch Grounded Copy to chat mode and keep your replies clear and direct.
Rewrite this text in plain language. Keep the meaning and facts, and remove filler.
Write copy from the facts I provide, then run the copy checker on the saved draft.
